title: Weighted Round-Robin Arbiter
constraints: Three requesters with fixed weights W = (3, 2, 1): requester i may hold the grant for up to W[i] **consecutive** cycles per turn. `gnt` is a registered one-hot (or 0).

State: the current owner `cur` and the number of grants `cnt` it received in this turn. Each edge: if `req[cur]` and `cnt < W[cur]`, grant `cur` again and `cnt++`. Otherwise search round-robin starting **after** `cur` (cur+1, cur+2, then cur itself) for the first requester. Grant it, make it `cur`, set `cnt = 1`. If nobody requests: `gnt = 0` (cur and cnt unchanged).
Synchronous reset: `cur = 2`, `cnt = 1`, `gnt = 0`, so that the first search starts at requester 0.
hints: Encode the search order as a rotation of `req`, then a priority encoder.
The requester continuing its turn doesn't search at all. Only a turn change searches.
Weighted round-robin gives bandwidth shares proportional to the weights (3:2:1 here) while still being starvation-free.
